analysis: Changes are small. (1) docs/architecture/inference.md: date bump plus a new paragraph (head lines 715-719) saying required/named tool_choice on Qwen 3.5-family checkpoints accepts the inferred .qwen35 parser or .xmlFunction, and that both concrete Qwen3.8-27B builds, including the embedded-MTP one, advertise forced tools. The rest of the doc is unchanged context. (2) ToolChoiceEnforcementPolicy.swift: the single hardcoded qwen38ConstrainedModelID is replaced by ModelRuntimeRequirements.qwen38ConcreteModelIDs.contains(model.id), so the MTP build is now eligible for forced tools (still gated by Qwen35TemplateFix.applies). In the parser-format check (~line 150), model types with the qwen3_5 prefix now set nativeQwen, so the framedFormat is .qwen35 rather than .nemotron. The guard still accepts only .xmlFunction or the framed format. Nothing here touches the E2E encryption, attestation, key, authorization or prefix-cache boundaries (TB-002, TB-007, T-041, T-008). The tool-payload validation path becomes stricter or equivalent: a .nemotron format on qwen3_5 is no longer accepted, and .qwen35 is. Security-relevant assumptions the next pass could not verify from the supplied evidence: the contents of ModelRuntimeRequirements.qwen38ConcreteModelIDs (defined outside the diff, so I cannot confirm it holds only the two exact IDs), and that invalidToolPayload still fails closed. The set was not retrieved; it is not shown to be a regression. No findings.
